set.body:
Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 1 of 6; child 1 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Define distinct visual-target, entity-key, and link-key types; namespace and revision rules; checked/versioned key codecs; compiler bindings on ordinary plots; and portable target metadata through statistics, grobs, device lowering, facets, and composition. Keep core free of browser/reactive dependencies and define the optional interaction module boundary. Establish membership capability contracts for future exact aggregate selection.

Acceptance criteria
1. Reordering and filtering preserve caller-supplied entity identity; duplicate unique keys fail explicitly while repeated grouping/link keys are allowed.
2. A logical mark drawn by multiple primitives remains one target. Point batches preserve compact per-index target references without forcing full source-row retention.
3. Count-only, representative, incomplete, and exact membership capabilities remain distinguishable. Exact-member actions cannot compile/validate against inadequate retention.
4. Key types survive typed subscriptions; codecs preserve namespace/schema/revision and reject incompatible payloads. Custom-stat source identity does not rely on row equality as proof.
5. Existing static render conformance and source/binary compatibility gates remain valid; attaching interactions to metadata-poor scenes requires explicit bindings or recompilation.

Exclusions
No event loop, widget UI, or claim that aggregate member selection is implemented.

Required evidence
JVM and Scala.js contract tests, adversarial identity/retention fixtures, batch memory/shape assertions, and compatibility evidence tied to the tested SHA.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
None: this is the first executable implementation slice.

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 01] Preserve typed interaction identity and membership capabilities through compilation
